item.title: V3.4.0 Stable
item.description:
Hello Survivors! 

Digging through a packed backpack in the middle of a horde is about to get much easier. V3.4.0 adds a search bar and filters to your backpack and containers, so you can find what you need in seconds. Stay alert, spend less time searching, and more time surviving!
